lines.t: Blessed are the hearts that whisper, “Yes, Lord,”
When the road bends and the sky turns grey.
Their faith shines through every storm and shadow,
A quiet strength that lights the way.
This is mature faith, tried and pure,
Trusting His plan when the answers blur.
Every breath becomes a sacred song,
“Your will be done,” as the journey goes on.
Blessed are the souls that pray, “Your will be done,”
They rest in truth when the battle runs long.
Their hope stands firm in the unseen promise,
Great trust born in the waiting’s calm.
This is mature faith, deep and still,
Rooted in peace, in His will.
Every day they walk in grace untold,
“Amen, Lord,” through both heat and cold.
Blessed are those who understand Him
For they know, The I AM WHO I AM, remains.
No fear can break their steady song,
Peace eternal carries them strong.
This is mature faith, full and free,
Living in light through every decree.
At all times, in every season and word,
Blessed are they who have truly heard.
Faith matured by surrender and fire,
Peace refined by hearts that aspire.
In knowing Him their spirits rise —
Mature faith, eternal where truth abides.
